name: Tear-off day counter
oneLiner: a tear-off desk calendar of real scanned paper under a brushed-metal clamp: pages rip off one after another on twos, faster and faster, each tumbling out of frame and leaving a ragged stub, until the last page shows Day N and a marker ring is drawn around the number
say: when the speaker names how long something took or a streak ('100 days in', 'day 30 of posting every day', 'it took me 90 days'): cut in on the number, the ring lands as they say it
